third_party_evaluations.summary: Core 350-701 SCOR plus one concentration covering network, cloud, content, endpoint, and secure access on Cisco.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Coverage across network, cloud, endpoint and secure access supports professional defensive responsibility at three years; the recorded Cisco-specific scope does not establish cross-vendor expert direction.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The core-plus-concentration scope spans network, cloud, endpoint and secure access, supporting professional security implementation. Production relevance and the three-year profile outweigh the vendor limitation without implying expert practical mastery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded core and concentration combination covers several security control areas at a three-year practitioner level. That breadth supports professional placement, with Cisco dependence and no documented lab limiting the ceiling.
